text_block_list.text: A few days after the Selection Race, while walking through the city――

text_block_list.name: Flyer Distributor
text_block_list.text: Hey, you there! Fancy checking out a Freestyle Race? Things are getting crazy hyped in the back alleys right over there~!

text_block_list.name: Flyer Distributor
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series is great and all, but freestyle's an absolute blast! ...Oh, little miss umamusume over there! You definitely don't wanna miss this either~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ――Freestyle...? Wait a sec, aren't you that trainer from before?!
choice_data_list: Hello, are you in the middle of running?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, pretty much! Just out for a light jog while mulling over that "style that suits me" thing you mentioned after the race. Something like that, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Anyway, freestyle, huh? I mean, I've heard about it, but I've never actually seen one live...

text_block_list.name: Flyer Distributor
text_block_list.text: Both of you hooked? Look at that! Come on in, come on in! You can even jump in and race on the spot, so go wild!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, s-sure!
Freestyle Races are underground races organized by umamusume who want to run unrestrained and free, utilizing vacant lots and open city spaces.
Even among those with blazing speed, some umamusume choose not to enter the professional circuit. Races where they can dash all-out with zero boundaries attract a passionate fanbase.

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Race Audience
text_block_list.text: (Woooooooaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Race Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
— "Ooooooooooohhhhh!"
— "Let's gooooooo!"
— "First place is mine and mine alooooone!"
choice_data_list: S-So, this is what freestyle's like……!

text_block_list.text: Their running form was raw and unpolished, yet overflowing with sheer passion! The sight of them laying their fighting spirits bare in an unfiltered clash was breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...The vibe here is totally different from official races. So this is what freestyle's all about...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa... this is seriously incredible. Just watching gets my blood pumping...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah... yeah! I wanna give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, you guys! Can I hop in too? I'm totally down for any race you've got!

text_block_list.name: Eyebrowless Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Whoa, jumping right in, are ya?! You've got guts, girl! Go for it. What's your name?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... Palmer. Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Tongue Piercing
text_block_list.text: Aah, Mejiro~ We got a fancy one here~ Well, that's a mouthful so I'm just gonna call you Palmer, 'kay~? As for your number, we'll draw it right at the gate before the start~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A-Alright? Just Palmer... works fine for me, I guess!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Tongue Piercing
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Well yeah~ It's super long, so nobody's gonna bother remembering it, get me? Then again, even if it's short, nobody remembers unless you win anyway~ right?

text_block_list.name: Eyebrowless Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, don't sweat it! Just gotta grab that win, yeah? The way we do things here, raw speed and muscle talk loudest. You ready to roll, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Got it! Thanks for having me!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: And they're off! Grabbing the early lead is number two in the red jersey, joining us as a wild-card challenger! Let's see how she holds up against the pack!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Okay, deep breaths, stay focused. Just run like I always do...!)

text_block_list.name: Determined Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: YEEEEE-HAWWWW! I'M LEAVIN' ALL Y'ALL IN THE DUST, BABY――!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (...Whoa, she's intense! Up close, her raw grit and spirit are practically burning! To think someone could run with this much swagger...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I wonder... should I just cut loose like that too...? Yeah... after all, this is a place where you can run completely free...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Besides, right now I'm just "number two" who jumped in on a whim! Not a Mejiro, just Palmer...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Win or lose, being a Mejiro doesn't mean a thing right here...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ――HRAAAAH! LET'S GOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Incredible speed! Unbelievable! The winner is number two, Palmer! She completely blew the competition away! A dominant victory by a massive six lengths!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ――Haa... haa... Maaaan, what was that... That was crazy! That felt so freaking good...!

text_block_list.name: Eyebrowless Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoaaaa! You completely crushed it, mate! Things are getting spicy around here! Give us another round, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Count me in! I wanna keep running...! I wanna... let everything loose and just charge full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: HERE I GOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (My legs won't stop...! The wind feels amazing...! My body feels lighter and better than it ever has before!)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Tongue Piercing
text_block_list.text: Woooow, Palmer's got some ridiculous legs on her~ Blowing past everybody like it's nothing~ ...Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haa! Haa! Haah! Ahaha... shoot, I might've gone a bit too wild out of the gate, ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Tongue Piercing
text_block_list.text: Pfft... ahahahaha! She got way too into it~! Didn't save anything in the tank, did she? Ahaha... she's hilarious~!

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Race Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Palmer! Go, go! Hang in there! Run away with it, Palmer! You've got this, Palmer~! Push through! Take the win~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright! This time my breakaway is definitely sticking, so keep your eyes on me! Everyone, etch this into your minds――!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: GAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!
By the time all the races on today's freestyle card wrapped up, the crowd's excitement around Mejiro Palmer had reached a fever pitch...

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Race Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: PAL-MER! PAL-MER! PAL-MER! PAL-MER!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, haha... I can't believe this is real, seriously. This is insane... Having everyone chant my name like this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: THANK YOU SO MUCH――――! THIS IS THE BEST FEELING EVER――――!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ――Phew~ I'm still feeling all floaty and hyped...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right? It was a totally new world for me... completely different from the Selection Race. Even people who had no clue I was a Mejiro were yelling "Palmer" at the top of their lungs...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, that felt amazing~ Hands down, the most fun I've ever had in my life! Y'know, I really wanna keep doing things like that from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah... yeah! I wanna burn the name "Mejiro Palmer" into everyone's memory... etch it deep!
Mejiro Palmer's eyes shone with blazing conviction. Watching her discover her very own dream firsthand, I couldn't hold back...
choice_data_list: May I help you achieve your dream?
May I help you achieve your dream?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! Was that... an offer for a contract just now? For real?!
choice_data_list: Absolutely! If you're okay with it!
Absolutely! If you're okay with it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you! That makes me super happy! Alright, so starting today... you're officially my Trainer! Looking forward to working with ya!
